contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
R/ GLORIA ROMANORVM ; D/ (D N GRATIAN

A copper-alloy nummus of Gratian, AD 367-383 (Reece period 19). Reverse legend reads GLORIA ROMANORVM. Reverse shows Emperor advancing right, holding standard and dragging captive. Mint is Lyon, AD 367-375 .See LRBC p.52, no.339. Obverse legend reads (D N GRATIAN - VS AVGG AVG). Obverse shows Pearl-diademed, draped and cuirassed bust right. Reverse fields and exergue read: OF II/- crescent &…
